question: _______________ won the 2025 UNESCO Award of Merit for its cultural heritage conservation efforts.

options.text: Our Lady of Grace Cathedral, Vasai

solution:
**The correct answer is __Our Lady of Grace Cathedral, Vasai.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• The **Our Lady of Grace Cathedral** in **Vasai, Maharashtra** received the **2025 UNESCO Award of Merit** for cultural heritage conservation.
 
• The recognition was given under the **UNESCO Asia-Pacific Awards for Cultural Heritage Conservation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Highlights__** 

 
• The cathedral is a **475-year-old structure** located in **Papdy village, Vasai.**
 
• Originally built in the **16th century during the Portuguese colonial period**.
 
• Architectural style reflects **Portuguese Baroque and Gothic influences**, adapted to local climatic conditions.
 
• The restoration was a **community-led initiative** involving local residents, church authorities, conservation experts, and historians.
 
• Conservation work used **traditional materials like lime mortar** to maintain structural authenticity.

**Significance:**

 
• The award highlights the importance of **community participation in heritage preservation**.
 
• It brings international recognition to India’s cultural conservation efforts.
 
• The recognition is expected to boost heritage awareness and tourism in the Vasai region.
